project.title: IDS Data Systems (New Democratic Party)

role_overview.summary: IDS Data Systems is a Canadian IT managed services provider engaged by the New Democratic Party of Canada to manage a concurrent cloud transformation covering both unified communications and a bespoke server workload migration. Christian served as Cloud Architect across two simultaneous workstreams, migrating the NDP's distributed on-premises Cisco CUCM phone system to Office 365 Skype for Business and migrating a bespoke citizen-data server workload from VMware to Microsoft Azure. Both engagements required alignment to sensitive security requirements — Protected B equivalent controls for citizen voting information — and were delivered within a compressed three-month window.

challenge.summary: IDS Data Systems required concurrent delivery of two cloud transformation workstreams for the New Democratic Party of Canada: migration of the NDP's distributed on-premises Cisco CUCM phone system to Office 365 Skype for Business, and migration of a bespoke citizen-data server workload from VMware 6 to Microsoft Azure — both requiring Protected B-equivalent security controls and completion within a three-month window.

solution.summary: Delivered comprehensive cloud and infrastructure solutions across:
deliverables: Office 365 Skype Migration - New Democratic Party of Canada
Server Workload Cloud Migration - New Democratic Party of Canada

outcomes: Migrated the NDP's distributed Cisco CUCM phone infrastructure to a fully cloud-hosted Office 365 Skype for Business environment, meeting security controls for unified communications systems and completing transition within a three-month window

Delivered a production-ready Azure cloud architecture for NDP citizen-data workloads meeting Protected B-equivalent security requirements, validated through HA and failover testing and deployed via blue-green model on a three-month schedule
